content:
It was recently revealed in an accidental post by the publisher itself that EA is preparing to reveal gameplay for an Iron Man game, with Motive Studios, the studio behind Star Wars Squadrons and the recent Dead Space remake, heading the development efforts. Beyond that, however, that first leak didn't really provide much information as to an expected launch date. However, a recent leak by MUTLeaks on X suggests that EA may be preparing to reveal the game during the 2026 The Game Awards show.
According to the leaker, Motive Studios's Iron-Man is expected to be revealed in two weeks (anytime between November 27 and 11, putting it right on time for a reveal at the TGA. Iron Man was first announced back in 2022 , and it is slated to be a single-player, third-person, action-adventure game, and prior gameplay footage showed Iron Man aboard a work-in-progress S.H.I.E.L.D. helicarrier and flying through what appears to be the city of Chicago.
